description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of a model, comparing various token-precision configurations for KV cache compression. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is divided into five discrete segments: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32", representing different ranges of model layers. The y-axis, labeled "Relative Change", is measured in percentage points and ranges from approximately -20% to +5%, with tick marks at intervals of 5%. The plot displays five distinct lines: a yellow line with circle markers representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", a cyan line with circle markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit", and a gray dashed line for the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit". The yellow line starts near 0% and slightly declines to approximately -1% before returning to near 0%. The red line begins near 0%, dips to approximately -5%, and then rises slightly to about -2%. The cyan line starts near 0%, declines to approximately -15% in Layer13-20, then rises to about -3%. The dark blue line starts near -5%, plunges to approximately -20% in Layer13-20, and then rises to about -5%. The gray dashed baseline remains constant at approximately 0%.
